# Browser libraries

Pinned files are served locally; visitors do not need a CDN, npm, or a build.

- `bignumber.js` 9.3.1 — MIT; decimal arithmetic for Laundry and fee calculations.
- `marked.umd.js` 15.0.12 — MIT; Markdown parser, loaded only on the Markdown page.
- `purify.min.js` 3.4.17 — Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0; sanitizes Markdown-generated HTML.

Original distribution URLs:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bignumber.js@9.3.1/bignumber.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.12/lib/marked.umd.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js

Keep upstream license notices. Review and replace these files deliberately when updating versions; there is no automatic dependency resolution.
